description: Whale and exchange flows for a token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, from its latest ~250 transfers: large transfers, deposits/withdrawals per exchange (Binance, Coinbase, OKX...), fund and market-maker flows, DEX buys vs sells, top accumulating and distributing wallets, and plain signals. Price: $0.02 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

chain.description: Blockchain: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon.

minUsd.description: Smallest transfer (USD) counted as a whale move.

name: token-whales

dexFlowsUsd.description: Tokens bought from vs sold into DEX pools.

exchangeFlowsUsd.description: Deposits to and withdrawals from labelled exchange wallets; net > 0 means outflow.

fundFlowsUsd.description: Large transfers to/from wallets labelled as funds or market makers.

largeTransfers.description: Transfers of at least minUsd, largest first (max 25).

topAccumulators.description: Wallets with the largest net inflow in the window.

topDistributors.description: Wallets with the largest net outflow in the window.

window.description: Transfers scanned and the time span they cover.

title: Token whales ($0.02)
